changes: done_prepare now prints pre-DONE merge-hazard guidance with exact paths (untracked-overwrite, branch divergence, merge conflicts, unrelated dirty files), a done_prepare re-run reason section (generated commits plus current head/material/storyFiles binding), and a generated-metadata delta that separates current-run generated files from pre-existing dirty lifecycle metadata. Fixed first-porcelain-row path corruption in handlers/done-prepare.ts gitStatusRows and core/done-prepare-generated-metadata.ts (whole-output trim stripped the leading status space, corrupting the first modified path and misclassifying lifecycle metadata as unrelated).
usage: lattice done_prepare '{"storyId":"B-xxxx","mergeMain":true,"refreshStale":true,"validate":true}' — on hazards it blocks with exact paths and safe next steps; commit the listed generated metadata and rerun, or use autoCloseGeneratedMetadata plus reuseFreshValidation for the one-command closeout; --dryRun inspects without writing.
expectedOutcome: Hazard fixtures report exact file paths and block before ambiguous DONE state; reruns print a compact reason (generated commit + current binding); a clean no-hazard story reaches DONE prepare: PASS unchanged; --dryRun leaves git status and story metadata byte-identical.
actualTranscript: npm --prefix packages/main run test:done-prepare-merge-rerun-smoke: done-prepare-merge-rerun smoke passed (7 scenarios); lattice validate: 45 commands, status pass, allPass true, verification coverage 9/9.
outcomeDiff: No difference — every scenario asserts the expected transcript lines and byte-identical snapshots explicitly.
limitations: Guidance is print-only and fail-closed: done_prepare never auto-resolves conflicts, stashes, or commits unrelated work. The re-run reason section appears when a run itself produced commits (refresh/auto-closeout paths). Porcelain consumers outside this story's call graph (dashboard.ts, cli-engine.ts, dirty-worktree-gate.ts) keep the pre-existing trimming helper untouched.
pitfalls: The first-row porcelain corruption is invisible to tests that only use untracked fixtures: ?? rows survive a whole-output trim, but ' M' rows lose their first path char — probe with modified tracked files sorted first. The F-002 fix touched a core file outside the scope contract and required scope_contract_acknowledge during REVIEW (fail-closed gate). Evidence storyFilesHash goes stale after every code commit; verification_evidence_refresh_stale rebinds it after the bound command is re-run green.
